Based on the supplied evidence, the planned availability of these three features is contrasted by target release date, plan-level access, and rollout structure:

- **Advanced OCR**: Targets general release on August 25, 2026 (v2.8.0) [NL-014-S03]. Availability is plan-specific: included natively in the Enterprise plan, offered as a paid add-on for Growth plans ($500/month), and not supported on the Starter plan [NL-014-S06].
- **WorkflowCoach public beta**: Officially targets September 29, 2026 (v2.9.0) for all active Growth and Enterprise accounts [NL-014-S03][NL-014-S05]. However, internal notes and engineering standups indicate the public beta may slip to November 2026 due to dependencies on the Advanced OCR Pipeline and permission synchronization engine, as well as observed latency and permission inheritance issues [NL-014-S05][NL-015-S05][NL-002-S07]. A private beta in September is possible only for customers without complex permission mapping [NL-015-S05].
- **Teams connector**: Strictly planned as a future release for Q4 2026 (v2.11.0, November release), with a restricted pilot beginning in October 2026 for selected financial and healthcare accounts [NL-014-S07]. It is not generally available; only the Slack connector is available as a limited pilot currently [NL-014-S07].

In summary, Advanced OCR is scheduled earliest (August) with clear plan-level tiers, WorkflowCoach has an official September target that is at risk of sliding to November (aligning it with Teams), and the Teams connector is firmly slated for November with an October pilot.
